# Third-party material in the skills

- `platform.pptx/assets/icons/*.png`: icons from [Lucide](https://lucide.dev) (lucide-static 1.61.0), rendered to PNG,
  ISC License (some icons derived from Feather, MIT). License text: `platform.pptx/assets/icons/LICENSE-lucide.txt`.
- The design rules in `pptx/SKILL.md` and the layout ideas in `platform.pptx/scripts/build.py` draw on the published guidance of
  [PeterKalmstrom/claude-powerpoint-skill](https://github.com/PeterKalmstrom/claude-powerpoint-skill) (MIT) and
  [MiniMax-AI/skills](https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/skills) (MIT). No code or text was copied from them.
- 基础读取指导改编自 zai-org/ZCode，commit 3c5b227649371507ddc4eb46ac5133afe6db1cab，Apache-2.0。
